questions.q: Which of the following is another name for the liquid valve?
Of the following, the best method used to determine the moisture level in a refrigeration system is to:
options: Weigh the drier after it has been in the system for a period of time
Visually check the sight glass for particles of corrosion
Test a sample of lubricating oil with phosphorus pentoxide

questions.q: A full-flow drier is usually recommended in a hermetic refrigeration compressor system to keep the system dry and to:
options: Prevent the products of decomposition from getting into the evaporator in the event of motor burn-out
Condense out liquid refrigerant during compressor off cycles and compressor start-up
Prevent the compressor unit from decreasing in capacity
Prevent the liquid from dumping into the compressor crankcase
questions.answer: Prevent the products of decomposition from getting into the evaporator in the event of motor burn-out

questions.q: Of the following, the main purpose of a sub-cooler in a refrigerant piping system for a two-stage system is to:
options: Reduce the total power requirements and total heat rejection to the second stage
Reduce the total power requirements and return oil to the compressor
Improve the flow of evaporator gas per ton and increase the temperature
Increase the heat rejection per ton and avoid system shutdown
questions.answer: Reduce the total power requirements and total heat rejection to the second stage

questions.q: In large refrigeration systems, the usual location for charging the refrigeration system is into the:
options: Liquid line between the receiver shut-off valve and the expansion valve
Line between the condenser and the compressor
Line between the high-pressure cut-off switch and the expansion valve
questions.answer: Liquid line between the receiver shut-off valve and the expansion valve
